title: Burgers, Cheese, and Villagers
description: Burgers, Cheese, and Villagers adds craftable burgers, cheese, and a new villager type, the burger seller, which spawns around the world with a new structure called the burger stand.
body: Burgers, Cheese, and Villagers adds craftable burgers, cheese, and a new villager type, the burger seller, which spawns around the world with a new structure called the burger stand. The trades are 1 emerald for a Burger or 1 emerald and a bucket of milk for 1 cheese, the recipes are also shown in the pictures in the gallery. The burger gives you 7 hunger bars and the cheese gives you 5.
